questions.text: How does the user pick the month of the summary?
options: Previous / Next month buttons around the month name
Both: Previous / Next buttons and a month picker
questions.reason: REQ-279 open question and walkthrough gap 8. It decides the page controls; the API takes a month either way (e.g. GET /summary?month=2026-11).
questions.answer: Previous / Next month buttons around the month name

questions.text: Which month is shown when the summary opens?
options: The current month (in IST, like 'today' in REQ-276)
The month of the most recently dated saved entry
questions.reason: REQ-279 open question. 'Today' is reckoned in IST everywhere else (REQ-276), so the current month would be too.
questions.answer: The current month (in IST, like 'today' in REQ-276)

questions.text: What is shown for a month with no saved entries? Please give the exact text (e.g. "No entries in November 2026.") and say whether a grand total of 0.00 is shown too.
questions.reason: REQ-279 open question. Not described in the documents.
questions.answer: No expenses in this month. No grand total is shown.

questions.text: In which order are the categories listed?
options: Fixed order of the sample, then the rest: Food, Travel, Rent, Entertainment, Health, Shopping, Utilities, Other
Code-table order: Food, Travel, Rent, Utilities, Shopping, Health, Entertainment, Other
questions.reason: REQ-279 open question and walkthrough gap 9. The sample order matches none of the usual rules; the acceptance table shows it, so the first option keeps the sample exactly as written.
questions.answer: Fixed order of the sample, then the rest: Food, Travel, Rent, Entertainment, Health, Shopping, Utilities, Other

questions.text: Can the user pick a month in the future?
options: No: the latest month is the current month (no future dates can be saved)
Yes: any month; future months simply show the no-entries text
questions.reason: Entries cannot be dated in the future (REQ-276), so a future month is always empty. This decides whether Next is disabled at the current month.
questions.answer: No: the latest month is the current month (no future dates can be saved)

questions.text: How does the user reach the summary?
options: A page at /summary with links between it and the entry box (/entries)
A page at /summary, and after a save the entry box shows a link to the summary of the saved month
Something else (please describe in a comment)
questions.reason: The app has only /sign-in and /entries, with no navigation. The walkthrough used a tab bar (Enter, Entries, Summary), but a saved-entries list is not built yet (REQ-280/281). '/' must stay the not-found page (WI-029).
questions.answer: A page at /summary with links between it and the entry box (/entries)
